meta.disclaimer: Passport-specific summaries are for trip planning only. Immigration rules change without notice — always confirm with the official source for your nationality before booking flights.

uk.label: Visa-exempt · 90 days
uk.note: The current DHA exemption schedule lists ordinary UK passports for 90 days. Entry permission and the period stamped at the border remain an immigration decision.

us.label: Visa-exempt · 90 days
us.note: The current DHA exemption schedule lists ordinary US passports for 90 days. A yellow-fever certificate may be required after travel through a listed risk country.

eu.label: Check exact EU passport
eu.note: EU and Schengen passports do not share one South African allowance. Most on the current DHA list receive 90 days, but Cyprus and Poland ordinary passports are listed for 30 days; verify the exact nationality.

au.label: Visa-exempt · 90 days
au.note: The current DHA exemption schedule lists ordinary Australian passports for 90 days.

ca.label: Visa-exempt · 90 days
ca.note: The current DHA exemption schedule lists ordinary Canadian passports for 90 days.

za.label: South African citizen
za.note: Use a valid South African passport for international travel and confirm any additional documents required for the countries on your route.

sadc.label: Check exact SADC passport
sadc.note: SADC nationality alone does not create one visitor allowance. The current DHA schedule ranges from no ordinary-passport exemption to 30 or 90 days depending on the country.

in.label: Visa required before travel
in.note: Ordinary Indian passports are not visa-exempt. Check eligibility for South Africa's ETA or eVisa channel and note that online eligibility can depend on the arrival airport.

other.label: Check exact passport
other.note: Use the DHA exemption schedule for the exact passport type and nationality, then check whether the ETA or another visa channel applies.

uk.label: eVisa or VOA · N$1,600
uk.note: Ordinary UK passports are in Namibia's visa-on-arrival programme. Apply online early or use in-person processing only at a supported port; the standard non-African adult fee is N$1,600.

us.label: eVisa or VOA · N$1,600
us.note: Ordinary US passports are in Namibia's visa-on-arrival programme. Apply online early or use in-person processing only at a supported port; the standard non-African adult fee is N$1,600.

eu.label: eVisa or VOA · check country
eu.note: EU and Schengen passports on the official visa-on-arrival list can apply online or use supported arrival points. Confirm the exact nationality, fee and port before travel.

au.label: eVisa or VOA · N$1,600
au.note: Ordinary Australian passports are in Namibia's visa-on-arrival programme. Apply online early or use in-person processing only at a supported port; the standard non-African adult fee is N$1,600.

ca.label: eVisa or VOA · N$1,600
ca.note: Ordinary Canadian passports are in Namibia's visa-on-arrival programme. Apply online early or use in-person processing only at a supported port; the standard non-African adult fee is N$1,600.

za.label: Visa-exempt
za.note: Ordinary South African passports are covered by Namibia's regional exemption arrangements. Confirm the permitted stay and carry a passport valid for at least six months beyond the intended stay.

sadc.label: Check exact SADC passport
sadc.note: Regional treatment varies by nationality. Check the exact passport against Namibia's exemption and visa-on-arrival lists rather than relying on SADC membership alone.

in.label: Holiday visa required
in.note: India is not listed for Namibia's visa-on-arrival programme. Use the official Holiday Visa service and obtain approval before travel.

other.label: Check exact passport
other.note: Check both the exemption list and visa-on-arrival list, then confirm whether your entry point handles in-person VOA, eVisa only, or neither.

uk.label: Visa-exempt · up to 90 days
uk.note: UK citizens are covered by Botswana's Commonwealth exemption. Visitor time is limited to 90 days in a calendar year; the border stamp controls the permitted stay.

us.label: Visa-exempt · up to 90 days
us.note: US tourist and business visits are visa-exempt for up to 90 days. Use Botswana's official eVisa checker before travel because bilateral exemptions can change.

eu.label: Check exact EU passport
eu.note: Botswana applies nationality-specific bilateral agreements, not an EU-wide rule. Check the exact passport in the official eVisa service before travel.

au.label: Visa-exempt · up to 90 days
au.note: Australian citizens are covered by Botswana's Commonwealth exemption. Visitor time is limited to 90 days in a calendar year.

ca.label: Visa-exempt · up to 90 days
ca.note: Canadian citizens are covered by Botswana's Commonwealth exemption. Visitor time is limited to 90 days in a calendar year.

za.label: Visa-exempt
za.note: Ordinary South African passports are visa-exempt. Carry a passport valid for at least six months and confirm the stay granted at entry.

sadc.label: Check exact SADC passport
sadc.note: SADC membership is not a blanket Botswana visa exemption. Check the exact nationality in the official eVisa service.

in.label: Tourism visa required
in.note: India is one of the Commonwealth countries Botswana explicitly excludes from the exemption. Apply online before travel; official guidance gives a typical 7–14 working-day service window.

other.label: Check exact passport
other.note: Use Botswana's official eVisa checker. Visa-required tourists should apply online and travel with the approval letter if instructed.

uk.label: Visa-exempt · up to 90 days
uk.note: The Zambia Immigration exemption list includes the United Kingdom. Visitors and tourists may be permitted up to 90 days in a 12-month period; KAZA is relevant only when an eligible itinerary also needs Zimbabwe access.

us.label: Visa-exempt · up to 90 days
us.note: The Zambia Immigration exemption list includes the United States. Visitors and tourists may be permitted up to 90 days in a 12-month period; KAZA is relevant only when an eligible itinerary also needs Zimbabwe access.

eu.label: Visa-exempt · check country
eu.note: Current Zambia Immigration guidance lists EU and Schengen nationalities in this profile as visa-exempt. Confirm the exact passport and permitted stay before departure.

au.label: Visa-exempt · up to 90 days
au.note: The Zambia Immigration exemption list includes Australia. Visitors and tourists may be permitted up to 90 days in a 12-month period.

ca.label: Visa-exempt · up to 90 days
ca.note: The Zambia Immigration exemption list includes Canada. Visitors and tourists may be permitted up to 90 days in a 12-month period.

za.label: Visa-exempt
za.note: The Zambia Immigration exemption list includes South Africa. Confirm the stay stamped at entry and any re-entry requirements for the rest of the route.

sadc.label: Check exact SADC passport
sadc.note: Zambia splits regional passports across visa-exempt, visa-on-arrival and prior-approval categories. Check the exact nationality rather than relying on SADC membership.

in.label: Prior approval required
in.note: India is on Zambia's prior-visa list. Apply through the official eServices portal and receive the approval letter before travelling; this is not a standard visa-on-arrival route.

other.label: Check visa category
other.note: Check whether the passport is visa-exempt, eligible for visa on arrival, or requires approval before travel. These are distinct Zambia Immigration categories.

uk.label: VOA or eVisa
uk.note: UK nationals are Category B: a visa is required but can be obtained at the port of entry or through the official eVisa service. Eligible travellers may consider the KAZA UniVisa.

us.label: VOA or eVisa
us.note: US nationals are Category B: obtain a visa at the port of entry or use the official eVisa service.

eu.label: Check category
eu.note: The EU / Schengen group is not one immigration category. Many passports are Category B and need a visa obtainable on arrival or online; check the exact nationality.

au.label: VOA or eVisa
au.note: Australian nationals are Category B: obtain a visa at the port of entry or use the official eVisa service.

ca.label: VOA or eVisa
ca.note: Canadian nationals are Category B: obtain a visa at the port of entry or use the official eVisa service.

za.label: Visa-free
za.note: South Africans visa-free — Beitbridge busiest SA entry.

sadc.label: Usually visa-free
sadc.note: Most SADC nationals visa-free — carry USD cash for park fees.

in.label: VOA or eVisa
in.note: Indian nationals are Category B: obtain a visa at the port of entry or use the official eVisa service.

other.label: Check / e-visa
other.note: E-visa portal open for many nationalities — rules vary by passport.

uk.label: eTA · 30 days
uk.note: UK ordinary passports are eligible for a 30-day tourist or business eTA. Complete the official online process before travel.

us.label: eTA · 30 days
us.note: US ordinary passports are eligible for a 30-day tourist or business eTA. Complete the official online process before travel.

eu.label: eTA or eVisa
eu.note: Eligibility varies inside the EU / Schengen group: several nationalities qualify for a 30-day eTA while others use the eVisa route. Check the exact passport.

au.label: eVisa
au.note: Australian passports are listed for the eVisa scheme rather than the 30-day eTA list. Apply through the official portal before travel.

ca.label: eTA · 30 days
ca.note: Canadian ordinary passports are eligible for a 30-day tourist or business eTA. Complete the official online process before travel.

za.label: Visa-exempt 30 days
za.note: South African ordinary passports are exempt for tourist or business visits up to 30 days.

sadc.label: Check exemption
sadc.note: Regional exemptions vary by nationality and permitted stay. Check the exact country in the official eligibility table.

in.label: eVisa
in.note: Indian passports are listed for the eVisa scheme. Apply through the official portal before travel.

other.label: Check eTA / eVisa
other.note: Use Mozambique's official eligibility table to determine whether the passport is exempt, eTA-eligible, eVisa-eligible, or embassy-only.

uk.label: eVisa or VOA
uk.note: UK nationals require a visa under the 2026 rules. Visa on arrival is available, but applying through the official eVisa portal before departure is recommended.

us.label: Visa required
us.note: US nationals require a visa under the 2026 rules. Use the official eligibility wizard to confirm whether visa on arrival is available or prior eVisa approval is required.

eu.label: Visa · check route
eu.note: The EU / Schengen group is not one Malawi category. The 2026 exemption schedule removed the former broad EU exemption; check the exact nationality and whether eVisa or visa on arrival applies.

au.label: Visa required
au.note: Australian nationals require a visa under the 2026 rules. Use the official eligibility wizard to confirm whether visa on arrival is available or prior eVisa approval is required.

ca.label: Visa required
ca.note: Canadian nationals require a visa under the 2026 rules. Use the official eligibility wizard to confirm whether visa on arrival is available or prior eVisa approval is required.

za.label: Visa-free
za.note: South Africans visa-free — Mwanza and Dedza borders from SA/Zambia.

sadc.label: Check exemption
sadc.note: SADC nationals are exempt only where Malawi's reciprocity condition is met. Check the exact passport in the official eligibility wizard.

in.label: Visa required
in.note: Indian nationals require a visa. Use the official eligibility wizard to confirm whether prior eVisa approval or visa on arrival applies.

other.label: Check visa route
other.note: Check the official 2026 exemption schedule and eligibility wizard; Category Two may use visa on arrival while Category One needs approval before departure.

uk.label: Visa-exempt
uk.note: Lesotho's official embassy nationality table lists UK passports as visa-exempt. Most routes transit South Africa, so confirm South African entry and re-entry separately.

us.label: Visa-exempt
us.note: Lesotho's official embassy nationality table lists US passports as visa-exempt. Most routes transit South Africa, so confirm South African entry and re-entry separately.

eu.label: Check exact EU passport
eu.note: EU and Schengen passports do not share one Lesotho rule. Some nationalities are exempt, some are exempt only for stays up to 14 days, and others require a visa.

au.label: Visa-exempt · up to 14 days
au.note: Australian citizens are listed as visa-exempt only for stays not exceeding 14 days. A longer stay requires a visa.

ca.label: Visa-exempt · up to 14 days
ca.note: Canadian citizens are listed as visa-exempt only for stays not exceeding 14 days. A longer stay requires a visa.

za.label: Visa-exempt
za.note: Lesotho's official nationality table lists South African passports as visa-exempt. Carry a valid passport and confirm any vehicle documents for the crossing.

sadc.label: Check exact SADC passport
sadc.note: Lesotho's nationality table is mixed across SADC: several passports are exempt while others require a visa. Check the exact nationality.

in.label: Visa required before travel
in.note: Indian citizens are listed as visa-required. Lesotho currently says its eVisa application system is suspended; follow Home Affairs' published email/manual application instructions before travel.

other.label: Check exact passport
other.note: Check the official nationality table. If a visa is required, note that Home Affairs currently reports the eVisa application system as suspended and provides an email application route.

uk.label: Visa-exempt
uk.note: The current Eswatini government nationality table lists the United Kingdom as not requiring a visa. Confirm the stay granted at entry.

us.label: Visa-exempt
us.note: The current Eswatini government nationality table lists the USA as not requiring a visa. Confirm the stay granted at entry.

eu.label: Check exact EU passport
eu.note: Most EU and Schengen passports in this combined profile are visa-exempt, but Eswatini publishes nationality-specific rules. Check the exact passport in the official table.

au.label: Visa-exempt
au.note: The current Eswatini government nationality table lists Australia as not requiring a visa. Confirm the stay granted at entry.

ca.label: Visa-exempt
ca.note: The current Eswatini government nationality table lists Canada as not requiring a visa. Confirm the stay granted at entry.

za.label: Visa-exempt
za.note: The current Eswatini government nationality table lists South Africa as not requiring a visa. Carry a valid passport for the international crossing.

sadc.label: Check exact SADC passport
sadc.note: Eswatini's published table is nationality-specific, so SADC membership alone is not enough to determine the requirement.

in.label: Visa required before travel
in.note: The current Eswatini government table marks India as visa-required. Apply before departure; official guidance says visa on arrival is suspended during the eVisa rollout.

other.label: Check exact passport
other.note: Check the official nationality table. If a visa is required, apply before departure because government guidance says visa on arrival is suspended.

kazaTip.label: KAZA UniVisa tip
kazaTip.note: Eligible passports: USD 50 at a designated issuing port for multiple Zambia–Zimbabwe crossings for up to 30 days, plus Botswana day trips through Kazungula. It does not cover overnight Botswana stays. Verify passport eligibility, port availability and payment method before travel.
